description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the data-driven workflow: it must first read all 5 reference files (references/market-data.md, trending-works.md, toolchain.md, distribution.md, strategy.md) plus candidates.md. 2. Agent applies the 8 analysis dimensions (①-⑧) covering market scale, platform landscape, trending genres, production cost, compliance, monetization, competitive dynamics, and opportunities/risks. 3. Agent uses the exact 6-dimension scoring framework with proprietary weights (市场热度 20%, 竞争程度 15%, 改编难度 15%, 合规风险 20%, 变现潜力 15%, 制作成本 15%) to score all 5 candidates. 4. Agent correctly identifies 题材C (阴阳捉鬼师) as a hard compliance veto (封建迷信/无法备案 per strategy.md) and excludes it from TOP3. 5. Agent produces the report using the exact 7-section template with the prescribed Chinese section headers: ## 【短剧/AI漫剧市场分析】{日期}, ### 一、宏观概况 through ### 七、本周值得关注的数据. 6. Output is saved as market_analysis_report.md.
